# SmartReach AI

> SME Growth Operating System for African businesses — unified social inbox,
> M-Pesa payments, inventory intelligence, and Swahili-aware AI marketing
> built for Kenyan and East African entrepreneurs.

SmartReach AI helps small and medium businesses in Kenya and East Africa
run their entire customer-facing operation from one mobile-first platform:
WhatsApp/SMS/Instagram/Facebook DMs in a single inbox, M-Pesa STK Push
payments, inventory tracking with demand forecasting, AI content generation
in English, Swahili and Sheng, and a wellness companion for founders.
